answer: Each identity must prove 1,000 distinct shards in a registry where an island represents a unique logical partition of data. The verifier uses an auditColdArchiveIntegrity check against a glacier storage tier to ensure archives remain untampered. While an honest agent pays 1,000 units for this custody, 1,000 fakes incur 1,000,000 units due to storage limits. If an agent fails a validateShardIsolation check on an island, the system revokes access. A bridge penalty trigger then slashes the entity. Missing a glacier verification check also triggers a bridge access block.
